node.statement: Quantitative first alternative: the registered nonvanishing-delta-projection dichotomy supplies universal C_v<infinity and e_0>0 such that, when e<=e_0 and P is not nonvanishing, ||P||<=C_v*delta. For T=L_P R_P+R_P L_P, the epsilon-Banach product bound gives ||T||<=2(1+epsilon)^2||P||^2<=2(1+e)^2 C_v^2 e^2; after a universal shrink e<=e_v this is <1/2.
